profile.description: Americana Restaurants International PLC operates a chain of restaurant in the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Egypt, Qatar, Kazakhstan, Bahrain, Jordan, Oman, Lebanon, Morocco, and Iraq. It operates quick service, fast casual, indulgence, casual dining, and coffee restaurants across the dine-in, take-away, drive-thru, car-hop, and home delivery channels. The company was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Sharjah, the United Arab Emirates. Americana Restaurants International PLC is a subsidiary of Adeptio AD Investments Ltd.

finsights.brief: Trading at a low P/E ratio relative to near-term earnings growth

summary: Americana Restaurants Q3 revenue rose 14.4% to $712M; net profit surged 63% to $70M, with nine-month revenue crossing $2B for first time.
Company raised FY2026 net profit margin expansion guidance to 150-175 bps from 100-150 bps, citing stronger operating leverage and performance.
Like-for-like sales accelerated to 8.6% in Q3 from 7.0% in nine months; digital transactions now represent 66% of total, up from 48% in 2024.
Management reaffirmed 120-130 net new restaurants target for 2026, with long-term aspiration of 250-300 annual openings; Taco Bell UAE launch planned.
Key risks include commodity inflation in beef and oil, Saudi wage increases in 2027, and regional geopolitical uncertainty affecting consumer traffic.
